Built the expense-approvals screen using Strata's `DataTable` (multi-select with checkboxes), `DataTableToolbar`, `Dialog`/`TextArea` for the required rejection reason, and `toast` to report how many requests were approved or rejected.

- `src/screens/Screen.tsx`: 10 mock expense requests (employee, category via `Tag`, `Amount`, date, `Link` to receipt with an external-link icon, and a status `Badge`). Rows already actioned become `disabledKeys` so they can't be re-selected. Approve acts immediately; Reject opens a dialog requiring a non-empty reason before it can be confirmed. Both paths clear selection and fire a toast with the count.
- `src/screens/Screen.module.css`: layout/typography using only `--strata-*` tokens and logical properties.

`audit_snippet` scored both files 100 with no findings. I can't run the dev server per the instructions, so this hasn't been visually verified in a browser — only checked against the Strata docs/audit tooling.
